pages.text: Build this at a crafting table. Place Blueprint Storage directly beside it, and load a populated blueprint.

pages.title: Make your first item
pages.text: $(li)Carry the required ingredients in your inventory.$(li)Right-click the Constructor.$(li)The top grid shows blueprints from adjacent Blueprint Storage. The lower grid shows your whole inventory, with a separated hotbar. Needed ingredients are bright; other items are dimmed and cannot be selected.$(li)Hover over a result to check what is missing.$(li)Double-click its blueprint to craft.$(br2)The result goes into your inventory. Leave room so it does not drop at your feet. Manual construction needs no flux supply.

pages.title: Reset devices for stacking
pages.text: Put one device that retains saved data into any crafting slot to get a fresh, stackable device of the same type. This also works in your inventory's 2x2 grid.$(br2)$(bold)Resetting destroys stored contents, fuel, installed Extreme Circuits, names, and settings.$() Empty valuable contents first. Cables, connectors, and tanks already drop clean items and need no reset.
